decision_rule.headline: all three primary suites satisfy noninferiority and the 25% target (intersection-union)
decision_rule.measured_saving: paired-root 95% upper bound of the amortized cost ratio below 1
decision_rule.noninferiority: paired-root 95% lower bound of (reuse - comparator) post-edit exact accuracy above -0.01
decision_rule.target: paired-root 95% upper bound of the amortized cost ratio at or below 0.75

circuit.rule: highest-accuracy restart (ties measured cost then K); least-cost reuse within 1 pp, else highest-accuracy reuse; no test selection

maze.rule: highest-accuracy restart (ties measured cost then K); least-cost reuse within 1 pp, else highest-accuracy reuse; no test selection

aborted_attempts.error: interrupted; time after last durable write is unobservable
